name: The Orphaned Soul
source:
A young girl, abandoned as an infant, goes on a search for her parents and identity in a dark fantasy world populated with foul beasts and nasty cuthroats.

Her childhood was a happy one, for the most part. But as her 21st birthday approached, her heart had a mysterious void, and only finding out long-hidden secrets and who her birth parents are will fill the empty space in her soul.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/911690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名在婴儿时期就被遗弃的小女孩，在充满邪恶野兽和肮脏凶手的黑暗奇幻世界中继续寻找她的父母和身份。

她的童年大部分时间都是快乐的。但随着21岁生日的临近，她的内心却出现了神秘的空虚，唯有找出隐藏已久的秘密，以及她的亲生父母是谁，才能填补她灵魂中的空虚。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/911690/]Steam[/url]]
